item.text:
Added view transitions to the product gallery. Each thumbnail and its detail hero now share a transition name so the image placeholder can morph between views. Next.js links tag forward and back navigation for directional page slides, and Suspense skeletons fade and move into content. The CSS disables these animations, including skeleton pulsing, when the user prefers reduced motion.

React and React DOM were updated to 19.3.1 because the previous installed version did not export `ViewTransition`.

Verified with a production build, TypeScript checks, and route smoke checks. I did not run a visual browser animation check.
